added.summary: Text is shaped in its language (CSS Fonts 4 §6.13): the element's lang attribute, inherited, or the OpenType language system font-language-override names, so a face's locl forms apply (Romanian Ș for Ş in Noto Sans), in Parley-laid paragraphs as well. Features carries the language (Features::with_language, Features::language), and og_text::shape::language_of_tag maps an OpenType language tag to the BCP 47 language HarfBuzz shapes in it.
